docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY LANDAS, CLARIBEL AS TO DEFENDANT SIMPSON, SHANI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-08-2000 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION DEC-08-2000, CONTINUED BY COURT TO JAN-30-2001 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506 TO BE HEARD WITH SMALL CLAIM CASE NO. 787719. DEFT WAIVES SERVICE OF PROCESS.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LANDAS, CLARIBEL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SIMPSON, SHANI $1,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $20.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,020.00, PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT AS TO DEFENDANT SIMPSON, SHANI
